name: Tallboy (Olympia)
description: A 24oz can of Olympia beer. Gold. Cold. The kind of beer that doesn't pretend to be anything other than what it is — cheap, available, and effective.

name: Tallboy (PBR)
description: A 24oz can of Pabst Blue Ribbon. The official beer of not having a better option. Tastes like college if you went to college, and like Tuesday if you didn't.

name: Pack of Cigarettes
description: Marlboro Reds. The pack crinkles in your jacket pocket. You know it's there the way you know your own heartbeat. Twenty cigarettes. Twenty small decisions to keep going.

name: Plaid Pantry Hot Dog
description: A hot dog from the roller grill. It has been rotating since morning. It has achieved a texture that is not found in nature. It costs a dollar forty-nine and it is the most accessible protein in Kenton.

name: Corn Dog
description: A dollar. Battered, fried, and sitting under a heat lamp long enough to develop convictions. It crunches when you bite it. This is reassuring.

name: 7-11 Coffee
description: Hot. Brown. Was brewed during a different presidential administration. The cup is styrofoam and too large and the lid doesn't quite fit. You drink it because it's warm and it costs eighty-nine cents.
